timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,500–1,523 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is currently weak (high KRW/USD ratio around 1,500+), making dollars expensive to buy. News indicates this is near 28-year highs (since Feb 1998), and while high volatility is expected to continue, multiple sources suggest the high-dollar environment may be peaking—foreign investor rebalancing is "in final stages" and rate declines are being anticipated, which could strengthen the won.

TIP: Consider splitting your monthly $2,000 purchase across weeks to average out volatility, or wait for pullbacks if won strength materializes, rather than buying the full amount at current elevated rates.
